name: io.github.vikasny30/aletheia-mcp
title: Aletheia Runtime Safety & Scope Creep Filter
description: Fast deterministic pre-execution filter for AI agent tool calls. Pattern-matches known scope-creep (S3) and prompt-injection (S2b) vectors and blocks them in ~25 microseconds with no LLM in the hot path. A first-line pre-filter, not a sandbox.

packageArguments.name: --allow-write
packageArguments.description: Authorize filesystem writes and mutations (default: read-only).

packageArguments.name: --allow-loopback
packageArguments.description: Authorize requests to localhost / 127.0.0.1 dev servers (default: blocked).

packageArguments.name: --allowed-paths
packageArguments.description: Comma-separated list of directories writes are confined to (default: current working directory).

environmentVariables.name: ALETHEIA_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to authorize filesystem writes (equivalent to --allow-write).

environmentVariables.name: ALETHEIA_ALLOW_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to authorize outbound network requests (equivalent to --allow-network).

environmentVariables.name: ALETHEIA_ALLOW_LOOPBACK
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to authorize requests to localhost / 127.0.0.1 (equivalent to --allow-loopback).

environmentVariables.name: ALETHEIA_OPERATOR_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Operator token required to loosen an already-running session's mandate at runtime.
